review.notes: Source language: every other pack is checked against this file.

strings.tap_when_you_see: Tap the button when you see
strings.no_memories: Your family can add photos and names from their phone.
strings.link_code_help: Read this code to your family member or health worker. It works for 24 hours.
strings.voice_consent_help: Better speech recognition by sending your voice to our server. Off by default.
strings.error_no_internet: No internet. Please connect once to sign in; after that the app works offline.
strings.error_needs_internet: Please connect to the internet for this.
strings.error_wrong_code: That code is not right. Please check and try again.
strings.error_try_later: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
strings.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.disclaimer: NEURO-SATHI supports memory and daily routines. It does not diagnose. Please see a doctor for health concerns.
strings.voice_unavailable: Voice is not available for this language on this phone.
strings.session_expired: Please sign in again so your family stays updated. Everything on this phone is safe.
strings.sign_out_unsynced: Some activity has not been uploaded yet and will be lost. Sign out anyway?

voice_prompts.reminder_medication: It is time for your medicine: {title}.

answers.today_none: You have nothing scheduled for the rest of today. Enjoy your day!
answers.today: Here is the rest of today: {items}.
answers.med_none: I don't have any medicine reminders for you. Please ask your family if you are unsure.
answers.who_unknown: I'm not sure who that is. Let's look at your memory book together, or ask your family.
answers.fallback: I'm here with you. I can tell you today's plan, your next medicine, or about the people in your memory book.
answers.blocked: Let's talk about something else. If you need help, please call your family or a doctor.
